name: ignited-stab-prepare-1-declined-base-power
notes: Ignited Stab (GRkBQ1Uvir, FIRE ASSASSIN ATTACK, reserve 1, printed power 2): "Prepare 1. [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Ignited Stab was prepared, it gets +2 POWER." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Player 2 declines Prepare 1: counters untouched, not PREPARED, only the printed 2 damage.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] On Attack: If Ignited Stab was prepared, it gets +2 POWER.
